request.title: Refute Printed.hardySobolevJetKernelProjection_tendsto (Theorem 9.3.2.6, p. 426)
request.body:
Closes #5331

Proves `Printed.hardySobolevJetKernelProjection_tendsto_false` (Theorem 9.3.2.6, (9.3.2.10), p. 426) in `RiemannMasullo/Ch09_HardySobolev/Sec3_Printed.lean`. Only the proof and private helpers placed directly above it, plus `import RiemannMasullo.ForMathlib.Analysis.Distribution.SchwartzSpace.Gaussian` (for `SchwartzMap.gaussian`).

**Counterexample.** `G = ℝ≥0ˣ` with identity module, trivial character, `I = [-1, 1]`, `s = 0`.
- Tests are built from log-profiles through `identityModulationExponentialDecay_equiv`: `p_c(x) = exp(-(x-c)²)`. Each exponential twist of `p_c` is a scaled translate of `SchwartzMap.gaussian 1`, so `p_c` lies in `logExponentialDecaySubmodule univ`.
- `φ` has profile `p_0 − p_1`. With the canonical Haar measure equal to `k • dt/t` (`k > 0`, uniqueness of Haar measure), `integral_cexp_quadratic` gives `M φ (z) = k √π e^{z²/4} (1 − e^z)`. This is entire, and its zeros `2πiℤ` all have real part `0 ∈ (−1, 1)`. So `(0, 0)` is an index of `J`.
- `W` is the library's `ModulatedIntervalSobolev m hm (-1) 1 0`, with `ι` from `modulatedIntervalSobolev_dense`. Its norm equals `intervalSobolevENorm` over `[-1, 1]`: the supremum of the endpoint densities is attained at `(-1, 1)`.
- Every `P T` maps into the kernel of `δ (0,0)`, which is continuous. So the strong limit `u` would satisfy `δ (0,0) u = 0` for all `u`. But for the Gaussian `g0`, `δ (0,0) (ι g0) = M g0 (0) = k√π ≠ 0`.

The star-projection part of the hypothesis is not needed.

**Checks run**
- `lake build` (full): `Build completed successfully (18994 jobs)`. Module rebuild takes about 9 s.
- `scripts/lint.sh`: `lint: ok`.
- Before and after dumps of `scripts/Signatures.lean` for this module are identical, and `scripts/signatures.sh --compare` lists nothing.
- `#print axioms RiemannMasullo.Printed.hardySobolevJetKernelProjection_tendsto_false`: `[propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. The `sorryAx` comes only from the upstream `identityModulationExponentialDecay_equiv` and `modulatedIntervalSobolev_dense`, which both show `sorryAx` themselves.
